draft.shortGloss: to play (game, sport, instrument); to act (role)
draft.emotion: relaxed and ready for fun or focus on a melody
notes: Use 'играть в' + accusative case for games or sports (e.g., играть в футбол — to play soccer).
Use 'играть на' + prepositional case for musical instruments (e.g., играть на гитаре — to play the guitar).
Imperfective; the perfective is сыграть (for a single game, piece, or role) or поиграть (to play for a while).
